reader.requirement: At --std 85 SOURCE identifier-1 is the sender of an implicit MOVE to the printable item, so (a) it must be a valid MOVE sender for that receiver under §1985:VI.6.19 (no index data item, SR4; GR3 a-c's category bans; level-2 de-editing of a numeric-edited sender is legal), and (b) the content must be moved by MOVE's rules, including GR5: a group sender is an alphanumeric-to-alphanumeric move with no conversion, whatever the printable item's category.

edition-consulted.switches: refuses at 85 the 2002 SOURCE forms (arithmetic-expression, ROUNDED), so at 85 only the implicit-MOVE arm exists

reader.edition-search: grep for DialectLevel|Edition|85|2002 in MoveTable16.cs (none in code), ReportWriterBinder.cs (lines 404 and 574 only: GENERATE summary and USE BEFORE REPORTING, not SOURCE) and ReportWriterEmitter.cs (only the Edition passed to the CobolReport engine). The validity chain and the transfer emit are the same at every edition
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no (the validity table and the transfer are edition-blind; 1985 level 2's legal numeric-edited-to-numeric de-editing matches the later tables)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses cover alphabetic-to-numeric, numeric-to-alphabetic and index-data-item refusals. Noninteger-to-alphanumeric, alphanumeric-edited-to-numeric-edited, de-editing, and a GROUP sender (GR5) are not exercised, and the group sender is the part that fails

reader.notes: The validity half conforms: every category ban and the index ban are refused, and de-editing works. The transfer half does not. ReportWriterEmitter.TransferImage passes every FieldReferenceSource to MoveEmitter.ConvertSource, which handles elementary senders only (its own comment says a group sender never reaches it). The group arm MOVE uses (MoveClassifier.IsGroupSender, then GroupRecord, as in MoveEmitter.RecordValue) is never asked, so a group SOURCE into a numeric or numeric-edited printable item is converted and edited as a number.
